scope: First evidence-backed generation findings for mixed or long-running Lund records in the app.

laterFactoryBasis.manufacturerLanguage: newly redesigned Lund Boats Alaskan series

findings.decision: Do not treat 1990s, 2000s and current Alaskan values as one unchanged hull. Preserve the 2003 1800 Sport as its own generation and create a separate redesigned 1875 generation when the exact introduction year is verified.

evidence.weightDifference: about 1,500 lb outboard versus more than 2,300 lb for some I/O versions

findings.decision: Separate propulsion architectures immediately. Outboard and I/O/ITS versions cannot share specifications, tow guidance or market values. Additional brochure comparison is required to divide the outboard record into exact hull generations.

evidence.layoutConflict: single-console and full-windshield boats share the name

findings.decision: Do not retain one representative specification set. Research each model year and separate full-windshield and console layouts where structural ratings differ.
Split by verified brochure-year hull specifications. Keep non-walk-through configuration status separate from hull generation so layout and structure are not conflated.
findings.confidence: material variation confirmed; exact generations pending
